question: Should OpenClaw make longest-prefix reload-rule matching the reload planner contract so narrower plugin hot prefixes can override broader restart prefixes?
rationale: This fixes the browser profile bug cleanly, but it generalizes reload precedence for all future overlapping plugin/config reload rules and therefore needs maintainer acceptance before merge.

options.title: Accept Longest-Prefix Precedence
options.body: Merge this shape after docs alignment, making narrower reload prefixes the planner contract across plugins.

options.title: Use A Browser-Specific Exception
options.body: Avoid changing generic precedence by adding a narrower browser-only core rule or browser-owned reload special case instead.

options.title: Pause For Reload Policy Design
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and define a broader reload-rule ordering policy before landing this PR.

recommendation.title: Accept Longest-Prefix Precedence
recommendation.body: Merge this shape after docs alignment, making narrower reload prefixes the planner contract across plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent source-history signal across the browser plugin, reload planner, browser profile refresh, and docs surfaces touched by the decision.
